fields.title: 📖 Three foundations of knowledge
fields.body:
🖋️ **Muḥammad ibn Idrīs ash-Shāfiʿī** said:

> ***“Knowledge becomes beautiful only through three things: Taqwā before Allah, attaining the Sunnah, and Khashyah.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** **Knowledge** needs more than sharpness of mind. It needs ***Taqwā, the Sunnah, and fear of Allah***, so that it becomes light.

immutable.source: 📝 Ibn Mufliḥ, al-Ādāb ash-Sharʿiyyah wa’l-Minaḥ al-Marʿiyyah, Faṣl fī Ṭalab al-ʿIlm, Band 2.
